subject: Hyperknow
account: User-provided logged-in session; no account identity is recorded in this file.
method: Manual ordinary-UI inspection in the user-authorized Browser Runtime tab. Only visible controls, accessible snapshots and screenshots were used. No cookies, local storage, tokens, hidden APIs, network interception or private data export were read.

visualizationTrial.prompt: Explain visually why 1/2 + 1/3 = 5/6 with a simple diagram.
visibleStages: Retrieved memory with an explicit no-relevant-memory state
Diagram is generating after explanatory text appears
responseStructure: voice, language, share and issue-report controls
continuity: the system records the activity in the left rail
follow-up prompts remain available above the composer
memory retrieval status is visible rather than hidden
visualizationTrial.qualityBoundary: The response is visually legible and progressive, but the observed UI alone does not establish factual correctness, pedagogical validity or stable retention.

learningFeed.recommendationBasis: Not observable in this empty account state; no ranking or recommendation rationale is claimed.

interactionNotes: the full unit outline is visible before joining
Materials can be extended with PDFs or a natural-language change request
Practices are grouped by unit and include practice, project and exam roles
opening a practice while unjoined displays a confirm dialog with course language choice
the dialog states that language cannot be changed after joining
coursePreview.costBoundary: No join confirmation, paid generation, purchase or course-content export was performed.

mechanismInference: A visible stage stream separates retrieval, explanation and media generation and lets text arrive before the diagram is ready.
Course outline, learning, practice, project, exam and a cross-session feed are presented as one continuous product rather than separate tools.
Completion-derived labels provide quick navigation but are insufficient for StudyAgent's measurement claims.
Source and memory affordances increase continuity; their truthfulness and privacy controls still require source-level validation.

implementedInThisBatch: safe fraction-bar renderer with same-whole, common-unit and count steps
explicit instruction that viewing a visual is not evidence of mastery
deferred: free-form generated visual code in student pages
family upload ingestion and page-level source preview
rejected: awarding mastery from viewing, completion or a single practice score
using hidden account data or private endpoints for benchmark evidence
